facts.fact: Decree 2016-357 of 13 May 2016 approves the statutes of ABNORM, a public administrative establishment created by decree 2012-821 under law 011-2007 on standardisation, certification, accreditation and quality, charged with drawing up and issuing national standards; the document names no information technology or data standard and states nothing on whether its catalogue holds one.

systems.country_label: Agence Burkinabe de Normalisation, de la Metrologie et de la Qualite (A.B.NOR.M)
systems.owner: State (public administrative establishment, under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Crafts)

note: Statutes give ABNORM general power to certify products, systems and persons against national or international standards; no IT or data standard and no named certification or certified organisation, so no certification fact.
